note: Public predictions by @MoneyBeastHQ, graded in public. Source of truth for outcomes: /workspace/growth/predictions.md (synced here). The Prediction grader updates result, actual, grade (and post when a call goes live) after each check; the site rebuilds from this file (python3 scripts/compose.py). Fields on every call: id, made, ticker, event, kind (buy/sell/sit-out/number/moves-less), call, check, result (hit/miss/pending/sit-out), actual, post, grade, note, setup (eps-vs-consensus/macro-line/implied-move/sell-into-print/priced-in/other), score (0-100 strength of setup, null if not scored), posted_on_x (true = has an X post, false = site-only call). Site-only calls (the weekly top-25 eligible earnings names, only the 1-2 strongest get posted on X) set posted_on_x false and leave post empty; if one is later posted, set posted_on_x true and fill post. Misses, sit-outs and pending calls stay listed. Never add $XYZ, Block, Cash App, Square, or Afterpay.
